ruleDefinitions.name: Code Execution via Pcwutl.dll
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects launch of executable by calling the LaunchApplication function from pcwutl.dll library.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "RUNDLL32\.EXE") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*pcwutl.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*LaunchApplication.*")))
